key_result: Grading needs no reference answer: programs check point-in-time correctness, recompute every reported metric and compare the strategy with the hidden specification.
takeaway: Proposes testing finance agents in an open world: they must find data on the Web, build their own backtest and satisfy a simulated user with a hidden strategy.
title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
why_it_matters: Closed benchmarks remove the failures that matter in finance, such as unverified data or a backtest that uses the future; this design measures them.
